phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Abstract interpretation analysis reveals critical state-space vulnerabilities in the sidecar verification flow. The analysis identifies multiple abstract domains where TOCTOU (Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use) vulnerabilities could enable a malicious proposer to modify sidecar contents after proof computation.

state_transitions: S1: BuildBlobSidecars(block, blobs, proofs) constructs sidecars → S2
S2: Broadcast sidecars to network → S3
S3: Verification (inclusion proof + KZG proof) → S4_valid | S4_invalid

data_column_state.domain: Composite(Column × Cells[] × KZGCommitments[] × KZGProofs[] × InclusionProof × BlockHeader)
state_transitions: S2: DataColumnSidecars(cells, proofs, block) constructs sidecars → S3
S3: Broadcast data columns to network → S4
S4: Verification (inclusion proof + batch KZG proof) → S5_valid | S5_invalid

variables.name: results.requirements
variables.purpose: Track which verification requirements are satisfied

variables.name: inclusion_proof_cache
variables.type: LRU cache keyed by sha256(inclusion_proof + block_root + commitments)

invariants: INV1: All requirements must be satisfied before upgrade to VerifiedROBlob/VerifiedRODataColumn
INV2: Cache keys are derived from immutable cryptographic hashes
INV3: Verification order is deterministic per requirement list

state_anomalies_found.description: Blob/cell data mutation window between proof computation and verification
state_anomalies_found.abstract_state_violation: The abstract state S = (blob, commitment, proof) is verified at time T_verify, but blob data was bound to proof at time T_compute. If blob is mutated in window [T_compute, T_verify], the verification validates a different state than what receivers will see.

proof_computation_point.state: S_compute = {blob: EL_data, commitment: C, proof: P, inclusion_proof: I}
proof_computation_point.binding: P = KZG_Prove(blob, C) - cryptographically binds blob content to proof

mutation_window.duration: Network propagation time + queue processing time
vulnerable_operations: proposer.go:480-503: broadcastAndReceiveBlobs() - sidecars passed by reference
proposer.go:506-527: broadcastAndReceiveDataColumns() - sidecars passed by reference
mutation_window.state_mutability: blob.Blob, blob.KzgCommitment, blob.KzgProof, dataColumn.Column, dataColumn.KzgProofs all mutable []byte slices

verification_point.state: S_verify = {blob': mutated_data, commitment: C, proof: P, inclusion_proof: I}
verification_point.vulnerable_if: blob' ≠ blob ∧ P = KZG_Prove(blob, C) ⇒ verification fails on honest data but could succeed on swapped data

attack_steps: 1. Receive valid (blobs[], proofs[]) from execution layer
2. Construct sidecars with BuildBlobSidecars(block, blobs, proofs)
3. AFTER BuildBlobSidecars but BEFORE broadcast, swap blob content: sidecars[i].Blob = malicious_blob
4. Keep original proofs/commitments unchanged
5. Broadcast modified sidecars
6. Receivers verify inclusion proof (passes - commitment in block body unchanged)
7. Receivers verify KZG proof (FAILS if implementation is correct, but window exists)
exploitation_vectors.impact: If verification incorrectly passes, receivers accept invalid blob data

exploitation_vectors.precondition: Fulu fork active, proposer creates data columns
attack_steps: 1. Receive valid blobs from EL
2. ComputeCellsAndProofsFromFlat(blobs, cell_proofs) → (cells[][], proofs[][])
3. DataColumnSidecars(cells, proofs, block) constructs sidecars
4. AFTER construction, modify dataColumn.Column[j] for specific cell j
5. Keep kzg_proofs unchanged
6. Broadcast modified data columns
7. Verification checks VerifyCellKZGProofBatch(commitments, indices, cells, proofs)
exploitation_vectors.state_divergence: cells[i][j]_original ≠ cells[i][j]_broadcast but proof[i][j] binds to cells[i][j]_original
exploitation_vectors.impact: Batch verification should fail, but mutation window allows inconsistent state

exploitation_vectors.precondition: Block body commitments and inclusion proofs are separate
attack_steps: 1. Construct sidecar with valid commitment C and inclusion proof I for C
2. I = MerkleProof(body_root, C, index) binds C to position in body_root
3. AFTER proof computation, swap sidecar.KzgCommitment = C' (different commitment)
4. Broadcast with inclusion_proof still proving C (not C')
5. Verification: VerifyKZGInclusionProof checks Merkle proof of C' against body_root
6. Should fail because I proves C ∈ body but checking C' ∈ body
exploitation_vectors.state_divergence: inclusion_proof binds to commitment_original but sidecar.kzg_commitment = commitment_swapped
exploitation_vectors.impact: Inclusion proof verification should detect mismatch

current_protections.effectiveness: WEAK - wraps protobuf pointer, underlying data still mutable
MODERATE - enforces all requirements before upgrade
current_protections.limitation: Doesn't prevent mutation between requirement checks within same verifier instance

current_protections.effectiveness: STRONG - cryptographically binds all cells/proofs atomically
current_protections.limitation: Only applies if all cells verified together; point-in-time check doesn't prevent pre-verification mutation

current_protections.effectiveness: MODERATE - prevents recomputation, key derivation includes commitments
current_protections.limitation: Cache key computed from current sidecar state, not original; mutation before cache check bypasses

gaps.gap: No immutable copy on sidecar construction
gaps.location: proposer_deneb.go:42-49 - sidecars constructed with direct references
gaps.risk: Proposer can modify sidecar fields after BuildBlobSidecars returns
gaps.abstract_state: S_returned shares memory with S_EL_source; mutations to S_EL_source propagate to S_returned

gaps.gap: No cryptographic binding check on broadcast
gaps.risk: No re-verification that sidecar content matches original proof before broadcast
gaps.abstract_state: S_broadcast assumed equal to S_constructed but no invariant enforcement

gaps.risk: blob.Blob passed to verifyBlobCommitment as []byte, could be modified during verification
gaps.abstract_state: S_verify_start might differ from S_verify_end if concurrent mutation

gaps.gap: EL mempool blobs/proofs have no verification requirements
gaps.risk: Blobs from EL trusted without validation; if EL compromised or proposer modifies after EL provides, no checks

recommended_constraints: CONSTRAINT-1: Enforce deep copy semantics on sidecar construction - BuildBlobSidecars should return sidecars with copied blob/commitment/proof data, not references
CONSTRAINT-2: Add cryptographic seal verification before broadcast - hash(blob || commitment || proof) stored at construction, re-verified before broadcast
CONSTRAINT-3: Make verification operate on immutable snapshots - copy sidecar data into read-only buffer before verification begins
CONSTRAINT-4: Add EL mempool verification requirements - at minimum verify blob-commitment binding even for trusted EL data
CONSTRAINT-5: Use compare-and-swap for verification state transitions - atomic check that sidecar state unchanged between requirement checks

state_anomalies_found.description: Multiple code paths create sidecars with shared underlying data structures

aliasing_analysis.aliasing_risk: If both paths can be reached for same block (shouldn't happen but no invariant enforcement), could create multiple sidecar instances pointing to same blob data; mutation affects all aliases
aliasing_analysis.abstract_domain_violation: Set{sidecars} assumed to partition blob data space, but aliasing creates overlapping sets

recommended_constraints: Add runtime assertion that blinded/unblinded paths are mutually exclusive
Enforce unique ownership of blob data - only one sidecar instance per blob

state_anomalies_found.description: Data column verification requirements allow ordering flexibility that could skip critical checks

order_analysis.gossip_requirements: data_column.go:28-41 - 11 requirements including inclusion proof and KZG proof
order_analysis.state_divergence: Data columns from different sources enter verification with different requirement sets; ByRange/ByRoot skip 8 security checks
order_analysis.abstract_state: S_gossip ⊂ Domain_strict_verified but S_by_range ⊂ Domain_minimal_verified; both can be upgraded to VerifiedRODataColumn but represent different security guarantees

recommended_constraints: Document security invariant differences between verification paths
Add explicit marker to VerifiedRODataColumn indicating verification level
Consider unified minimum requirement set across all sources

key_findings: Sidecar data structures are mutable throughout the construction → broadcast → verification pipeline, creating a TOCTOU vulnerability window
No cryptographic binding is enforced between the state when proofs are computed and when verification occurs
The ROBlob/RODataColumn 'read-only' wrappers provide naming convention security only; underlying data is fully mutable via embedded pointers
Verification operates on references to mutable data rather than immutable snapshots, allowing concurrent modification during verification
EL mempool data is completely trusted with zero verification requirements, creating a trust boundary violation
state_invariant_violations: INVARIANT: blob content immutable after proof binding → VIOLATED (blob is []byte passed by reference)
INVARIANT: sidecars broadcast == sidecars constructed → NOT ENFORCED (no cryptographic seal)
INVARIANT: verification input state == proof computation state → ASSUMED NOT PROVEN (temporal gap with mutation window)
INVARIANT: read-only wrapper prevents mutation → FALSE (wraps pointer to mutable protobuf)
next_phase_focus: Symbolic execution to identify specific mutation sequences that bypass verification
Formal proof of absence of valid attack paths or demonstration of concrete exploit
Analysis of whether KZG cryptographic properties prevent all mutation attacks despite implementation gaps
